meta.name: add-karpathy-llm-wiki
meta.description: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to a NanoClaw group. Based on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern. Triggers on "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", "llm wiki", "karpathy wiki".

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为群组添加持久化知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在群聊中共享和查询持久化的知识库内容。
copy.tagline_en: Add a persistent wiki knowledge base to your group
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to share and query a persistent knowledge base in group chats.

howto.what: Claude 会为你的 NanoClaw 群组搭建一个基于 Karpathy LLM Wiki 模式的持久 wiki 知识库:创建目录和索引文件,添加一个容器技能,并更新群组说明,让群组按你设定的领域和来源类型持续维护 wiki。
howto.when: 当你在 NanoClaw 里提到 "add wiki"、"wiki"、"knowledge base" 等触发词时触发。

say.text: 给这个群组添加一个 wiki 知识库。
say.note: Claude 会开始搭建 wiki 并询问细节。

say.text: 我想用 Karpathy 的模式给群组建一个知识库。
say.note: Claude 会先介绍该模式再和你讨论。

say.text: 帮我把这个群组改造成带 wiki 的结构。
say.note: Claude 会询问选择哪个群组并逐步配置。

howto.what_en: Claude sets up a persistent wiki for your NanoClaw group per Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern: creates wiki/ and sources/ directories, index files, a container skill, and updates CLAUDE.md with wiki maintenance rules so the group keeps maintaining the wiki for your domain and sources.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "add wiki", "wiki", "knowledge base", or similar words in NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add a wiki knowledge base to this group.
say_en.note: Claude will start setting up the wiki and ask for details.

say_en.text: I want to build a knowledge base for the group using Karpathy's pattern.
say_en.note: Claude explains the pattern first, then discusses.

say_en.text: Help me turn this group into a wiki structure.
say_en.note: Claude asks which group to use and configures step by step.
